en.t: He had a friend who had gone mad.

units.source_text: 他对这个朋友一向有某种亲近感。

en.t: He had always felt a certain closeness to this friend.

units.source_text: 因为他比任何人都更深刻地理解这个朋友的孤独——欢愉的假面下所掩藏的真实的孤独。

en.t: Because he understood this friend’s loneliness more deeply than anyone else did, the true loneliness hidden beneath the mask of pleasure.

units.source_text: 这个朋友发疯后，他曾经去看望过两三次。

en.t: After this friend went mad, he had gone to visit him two or three times.
